name: Vengeance
overview: The account of the sons of Jacob and their actions against Hamor and Shechem illustrates a vivid instance of vengeance in Scripture, where Simeon and Levi respond decisively to an offense by killing all the males of the city after a deceptive peace agreement involving circumcision. This narrative reveals that vengeance, while a serious and weighty matter, ultimately belongs to God, who alone has authority over justice and retribution. The events underscore the complexity of human responses to wrongdoing within God's sovereign plan.
